data.title: Why Amazon And Walmart’s AI Shopping Agents Are Rigged Against ‘Made In USA’
data.description: A Columbia Law School study finds Amazon and Walmart's AI agents hide American-made goods, enable false origin claims, while the AI agents admit it's a business choice.
data.author: Pamela N. Danziger
data.keywords: Amazon,Made in USA,Walmart,Product origin labels online,Made in America products,Country-of-origin fraud,Consumer demand for Made in USA products,AI agentic shopping agents bias
